results.title: Η Ιστορια της Αφροδιτης της Μήλος / The Story of the Aphrodite of Milos
results.creator: Gianni M. Chalkoutsaki
results.description: A general history of the Aphrodite of Milos (Venus de Milo). The author wrote the book with Greek readers in mind. The author's stated purpose was to methodically compare accounts and eyewitness stories to find the truth about the discovery of the statue, and what happened to the statue subsequently. A quick history of the island of Milos, a small number of illustrations and two maps are included. A few pages are legible but slightly blurry in the gutters due to scanning. There is some Greek handwriting in a few spots (notes)?

results.title: Meme Wars: The Untold Story of The Online Battles Upending Democracy in America - Joan Donovan, Emily Dreyfuss, Brian Friedburg
results.creator: Joan Donovan, Emily Dreyfuss, Brian Fredburg
results.description: "Memes have long been dismissed as inside jokes with no political importance. Nothing could be further from the truth. Memes are bedrock to the strategy of conspiracists such as Alex Jones, provocateurs like Milo Yiannopoulos, white nationalists like Nick Fuentes, and tacticians like Roger Stone. While the media and most politicians struggle to harness the organizing power of the internet, the “redpill right” weaponizes memes, pushing conspiracy theories and disinformation into the mainstream to drag people down the rabbit hole. These meme wars stir strong emotions, deepen partisanship, and get people off their keyboards and into the streets--and the steps of the US Capitol."
